zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi innī a'ūdhu bika an as'alaka mā laysa lī bihi 'ilmun wa illā taghfir lī wa tarḥamnī akun minal-khāsirīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be among the losers.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa liwālidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and believing women.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka antas-samī'ul-'alīm, wa tub 'alaynā innaka antat-tawwābur-raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. And accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi-j'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī rabbanā wa taqabbal du'ā'
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi hab lī ḥukmān wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa-j'al lī lisāna ṣidqin fil-ākhirīn, wa-j'alnī min warathati jannatin-na'īm
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous, and give me a reputation of honor among later generations, and place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, grant me a child from the righteous.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā 'alayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā fitnatan lilladhīna kafarū wa-ghfir lanā rabbanā innaka antal-'azīzul-ḥakīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us. Our Lord, indeed You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakal-latī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāh, wa adkhilnī biraḥmatika fī 'ibādikāṣ-ṣāliḥīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness of which You approve, and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka samī'ud-du'ā'
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi lā tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-wārithīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

zikr_from_book.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī wa-ḥlul 'uqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa li'akhī wa adkhilnā fī raḥmatika wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattaba'nar-rasūla faktubnā ma'ash-shāhidīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our transgressions in our affairs, and plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi zidnī 'ilmā
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi a'ūdhu bika min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa a'ūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge with You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi-ghfir wa-rḥam wa anta khayru-rāḥimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā wa anta khayru-rāḥimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, for You are the best of the merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ṣrif 'annā 'adhāba jahannama inna 'adhābahā kāna gharamā, innahā sā'at mustaqarran wa muqāmā
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin wa-j'alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakal-latī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī, innī tubtu ilayka wa innī minal-muslimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve, and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā wa li'ikhwāninalla-dhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmāni wa lā taj'al fī qulūbinā ghillan lilladhīna āmanū, rabbanā innaka ra'ūfun raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt wa lā tazidiẓ-ẓālimīna illā tabārā
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir 'annā sayyi'ātinā wa tawaffanā ma'al-abrār
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa'adtanā 'alā rusulika wa lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, innaka lā tukhliful-mī'ād
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in Your promise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā wa anta khayru-rāḥimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and have mercy upon us, for You are the best of the merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā, rabbanā wa lā taḥmil 'alaynā iṣran kamā ḥamalтahu 'alal-ladhīna min qablinā, rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, wa-'fu 'annā wa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā ba'da idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmah, innakaantal-wahhāb
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā innaka jāmi'un-nāsi li-yawmin lā rayba fīh, innallāha lā yukhliful-mī'ād
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā innanā sami'nā munādiyan yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū birabbikum fa-āmannā, rabbanā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir 'annā sayyi'ātinā wa tawaffanā ma'al-abrār, rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa'adtanā 'alā rusulika wa lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, innaka lā tukhliful-mī'ād
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying: Believe in your Lord, and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in Your promise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā-kshif 'annal-'adhāba innā mu'minūn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, remove from us the punishment; indeed, we are believers.

zikr_from_book.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Rabbanā afrigh 'alaynā ṣabran wa tawaffanā muslimīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min fitnatil-nāri wa 'adhābin-nār, wa fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhābil-qabr, wa sharri fitnatil-ghinā, wa sharri fitnatil-faqr, wa min sharri fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the trial of the Fire and the punishment of the Fire, and the trial of the grave and the punishment of the grave, and the evil of the trial of wealth, and the evil of the trial of poverty, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-kasali wal-harami wal-maghram wal-ma'tham
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from laziness, old age, debt, and sin.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-harami wal-bukhli wa 'adhābil-qabr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, old age, miserliness, and the punishment of the grave.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghsilnī min khaṭāyāya bil-mā'i wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqinī minal-khaṭāyā kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas, wa bā'id baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bā'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with water, snow and ice, purify me of sins as a white garment is purified of filth, and put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the East and the West.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from sin and from debt.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wal-harami wa 'adhābil-qabr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, old age, and the punishment of the grave.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma āti nafsī taqwāhā wa zakkihā anta khayru man zakkāhā, anta waliyyuhā wa mawlāhā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, grant my soul its righteousness and purify it, for You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and Master.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa', wa min qalbin lā yakhsha', wa min nafsin lā tashba', wa min da'watin lā yustajābu lahā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit, a heart that does not fear, a soul that is never satisfied, and a supplication that is not answered.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-hdinī wa saddidnī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, guide me and keep me on the right path.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā wat-tuqā wal-'afāfa wal-ghinā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفَجْأَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min zawāli ni'matika wa taḥawwuli 'āfiyatika wa faj'ati niqmatika wa jamī'i sakhaṭik
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of Your protection, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā 'amiltu wa min sharri mā lam a'mal
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done and the evil of what I have not done.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي مَالِي وَوَلَدِي وَأَطِلْ حَيَاتِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَأَحْسِنْ عَمَلِي وَاغْفِرْ لِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma bārik lī fī mālī wa waladī wa aṭil ḥayātī 'alā ṭā'atika wa aḥsin 'amalī wa-ghfir lī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, bless me in my wealth and my children, extend my life in obedience to You, make my deeds good, and forgive me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالسَّدَادَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā was-sadād
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance and right conduct.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min khayri mā sa'alaka minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri masta'ādha minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa antal-musta'ānu wa 'alaykal-balāgh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of what Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sought refuge from. You are the One from Whom help is sought, and it is upon You to convey, and there is no power or strength except with Allah.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min sharri sam'ī wa min sharri baṣarī wa min sharri lisānī wa min sharri qalbī wa min sharri maniyyī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of my hearing, the evil of my sight, the evil of my tongue, the evil of my heart, and the evil of my desires.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-baraṣi wal-junūni wal-judhāmi wa min sayyi'il-asqām
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from leprosy, insanity, elephantiasis, and the worst of diseases.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min munkarātil-akhlāqi wal-a'māli wal-ahwā'
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from bad character, bad deeds, and bad desires.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun karīmun tuḥibbul-'afwa fa-'fu 'annī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, Generous, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةَ قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka fi'lal-khayrāti wa tarkal-munkarāt, wa ḥubbal-masākīn, wa an taghfira lī wa tarḥamanī, wa idhā aradta fitnataqawmin fatawaffanī ghayra maftūn, wa as'aluka ḥubbaka wa ḥubba man yuḥibbuka wa ḥubba 'amalin yuqarribunī ilā ḥubbik
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to grant me the doing of good deeds, the abandoning of evil deeds, and the love of the poor. Forgive me and have mercy on me. And when You intend to put a people in trial, take me without being tried. I ask You for Your love, and the love of those who love You, and the love of deeds that bring me closer to Your love.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min khayri hādhihil-laylati wa khayri mā fīhā, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā fīhā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night and the good that is in it, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of this night and the evil that is in it.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra mā sa'alaka 'ibādukaṣ-ṣāliḥūn, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri masta'ādha minhu 'ibādukaṣ-ṣāliḥūn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your righteous servants asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of what Your righteous servants sought refuge from.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ وَثَبِّتْنِي وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِي وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلَاتِي وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayral-mas'alati wa khayrad-du'ā', wa khayran-najāḥ, wa khayral-'amal, wa khayrath-thawāb, wa khayral-ḥayāh, wa khayral-mamāt, wa thabbitnī wa thaqqil mawāzīnī wa ḥaqqiq īmānī wa-rfa' darajātī wa taqabbal ṣalātī wa-ghfir khaṭī'atī, wa as'alukaD-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the best of requests, the best of supplication, the best of success, the best of deeds, the best of reward, the best of life, and the best of death. Keep me firm, make my scales heavy, make my faith true, raise my ranks, accept my prayer, forgive my sin, and I ask You for the highest degrees of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتُحَصِّنَ فَرْجِي وَتُنَوِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka an tarfa'a dhikrī wa taḍa'a wizrī wa tuṣliḥa amrī wa tuṭahhira qalbī wa tuḥaṣṣina farjī wa tunawwira qalbī wa taghfira lī dhanbī, wa as'alukaD-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to raise my mention, remove my burden, set right my affairs, purify my heart, guard my chastity, illuminate my heart, and forgive my sin. And I ask You for the highest degrees of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الصِّحَّةَ فِي نَفْسِي وَفِي سَمْعِي وَفِي بَصَرِي وَفِي رُوحِي وَفِي خَلْقِي وَفِي خُلُقِي وَفِي أَهْلِي وَفِي مَحْيَايَ وَفِي مَمَاتِي وَفِي عَمَلِي وَتَقَبَّلْ حَسَنَاتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukaṣ-ṣiḥḥata fī nafsī wa fī sam'ī wa fī baṣarī wa fī rūḥī wa fī khalqī wa fī khuluqī wa fī ahlī wa fī maḥyāya wa fī mamātī wa fī 'amalī wa taqabbal ḥasanātī, wa as'alukaD-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for health in my body, in my hearing, in my sight, in my spirit, in my creation, in my character, in my family, in my life, in my death, and in my deeds. Accept my good deeds, and I ask You for the highest degrees of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ وَالْأَدْوَاءِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma jannibni munkarātil-akhlāqi wal-a'māli wal-ahwā'i wal-adwā'
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, keep me away from evil character, evil deeds, evil desires, and diseases.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma bārik lī fīmā razaqtanī wakhluf 'alayya kulla ghā'ibatin lī bikhayrin
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, bless me in what You have provided me and replace with good everything of mine that is absent.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَاسِبْنِي حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ḥāsibnī ḥisābān yasīrā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, call me to account with an easy reckoning.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma a'innī 'alā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni 'ibādatik
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You well.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ وَمُرَافَقَةَ النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَعْلَى دَرَجَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka īmānan lā yartaddu wa na'īman lā yanfadu wa murāfaqatan-nabiyyi Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa sallama fī a'lā darajātil-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not waver, bliss that does not end, and the companionship of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in the highest ranks of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma qanni'nī bimā razaqtanī wa bārik lī fīhi wakhluf 'alayya kulla ghā'ibatin lī bikhayrin
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, bless me in it, and replace with good everything of mine that is absent.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-hdinī wa-'āfinī wa-rzuqnī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me wellbeing, and provide for me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَعَافِنِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-hdinī wa-rzuqnī wa-'āfinī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, provide for me, and grant me wellbeing.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīniyal-ladhī huwa 'iṣmatu amrī, wa aṣliḥ lī dunyāyal-latī fīhā ma'āshī, wa aṣliḥ lī ākhiratīyal-latī fīhā ma'ādī, wa-j'alil-ḥayāta ziyādatan lī fī kulli khayr, wa-j'alil-mawta rāḥatan lī min kulli sharr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, set right for me my worldly life in which is my livelihood, set right for me my Hereafter which is my return, make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a rest for me from every evil.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa ḍala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from anxiety and grief, incapacity and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt, and being overpowered by people.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, 'ālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, anta taḥkumu bayna 'ibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn, ihdinī limakhtalafa fīhi minal-ḥaqqi bi'idhnik, innaka tahdī man tashā'u ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between Your servants in that over which they used to differ. Guide me to the truth in what has been disputed, by Your permission. Indeed You guide whom You will to a straight path.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīran wa lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā anta fa-ghfir lī maghfiratan min 'indika war-ḥamnī innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly and none forgives sins but You, so forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَآمَنْتُ بِكَ وَتَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ وَأَنَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَخَاصَمْتُ بِكَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayka wa āmantu bika wa tawakkaltu 'alayka wa anabtu ilayka wa khāṣamtu bik
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, believed in You, relied upon You, turned to You in repentance, and argued by You.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bi'izzatika lā ilāha illā anta an tuḍillanī, antal-ḥayyul-ladhī lā yamūt, wal-jinnu wal-insu yamūtūn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might — there is no god but You — from being led astray. You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while the jinn and mankind die.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka mūjibāti raḥmatika wa 'azā'ima maghfiratika was-salāmata min kulli ithm, wal-ghanīmata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannah, wan-najāta minan-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for that which necessitates Your mercy, the resolve for Your forgiveness, safety from every sin, the benefit of every good deed, victory in Paradise, and salvation from the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي دَارِي وَسَعِّدْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhanbī wa bārik lī fī dārī wa sa'id lī fī rizqī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive me my sin, bless me in my home, and bless me in my provision.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlika wa raḥmatika fa'innahū lā yamlukuhā illā ant
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty and mercy, for none possesses them but You.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَدْمِ وَالتَّرَدِّي وَالْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرَقِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِرًا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ لَدِيغًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hadmi wat-taraddī wal-gharaqi wal-ḥaraqi wal-haram, wa a'ūdhu bika an yatakhabbataṭanish-shayṭānu 'indal-mawt, wa a'ūdhu bika an amūta fī sabīlika mudbiran, wa a'ūdhu bika an amūta ladīghā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from being crushed by a falling structure, from falling from a height, from drowning, from burning, from extreme old age, from being tormented by Shaytān at the time of death, from dying while fleeing from battle in Your cause, and from dying by a venomous sting.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-jū'i fa'innahū bi'saḍ-ḍajī', wa a'ūdhu bika minal-khiyānati fa'innahā bi'satil-biṭānah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from hunger, for it is a wretched companion, and I seek refuge with You from treachery, for it is a wretched inner trait.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْقَسْوَةِ وَالْغَفْلَةِ وَالْعَيْلَةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَالْمَسْكَنَةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْكُفْرِ وَالْفُسُوقِ وَالشِّقَاقِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ وَالرِّيَاءِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الصَّمَمِ وَالْبَكَمِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَالْبَرَصِ وَسَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wal-harami wal-qaswati wal-ghaflati wal-'aylati wadh-dhillati wal-maskanah, wa a'ūdhu bika minal-faqri wal-kufri wal-fusūqi wash-shiqāqi wan-nifāqi was-sum'ati war-riyā', wa a'ūdhu bika minaṣ-ṣamami wal-bakam wal-junūni wal-judhāmi wal-baraṣi wa sayyi'il-asqām
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, old age, hardheartedness, heedlessness, poverty, humiliation, and destitution. I seek refuge with You from destitution, disbelief, wickedness, discord, hypocrisy, seeking reputation, and showing off. And I seek refuge with You from deafness, muteness, insanity, elephantiasis, leprosy, and evil diseases.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-faqri wal-qillati wadh-dhillah, wa a'ūdhu bika min an aẓlima aw uẓlam
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation, and I seek refuge with You from wronging others or being wronged.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَارِ السَّوْءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ جَارَ الْبَادِيَةِ يَتَحَوَّلُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min jāris-saw'i fī dāril-muqāmah, fa'inna jāral-bādiyati yataḥawwal
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from a bad neighbor in a permanent dwelling, for the neighbor of the desert moves on.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَرْبَعِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min nafsin lā tashba', wa min qalbin lā yakhsha', wa min 'ilmin lā yanfa', wa min da'watin lā yustajābu lahā, wa a'ūdhu bika min hā'ulā'il-arba'
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from a soul that is never satisfied, a heart that does not fear, knowledge that does not benefit, and a supplication that is not answered. I seek refuge with You from these four.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ السَّوْءِ وَمِنْ لَيْلَةِ السَّوْءِ وَمِنْ سَاعَةِ السَّوْءِ وَمِنْ صَاحِبِ السَّوْءِ وَمِنْ جَارِ السَّوْءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min yawmis-saw', wa min laylatissaw', wa min sā'atissaw', wa min ṣāḥibissaw', wa min jārissaw'i fī dāril-muqāmah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from a bad day, a bad night, a bad hour, a bad companion, and a bad neighbor in a permanent dwelling.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa astajīru bika minan-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek Your protection from the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْنِي فِي الدِّينِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma faqqihnī fid-dīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, grant me understanding in the religion.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā a'lam
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَانْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma 'allimnī mā yanfa'unī wan-fa'nī bimā 'allamtanī wa zidnī 'ilmā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, teach me what benefits me, benefit me with what You have taught me, and increase me in knowledge.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan ṭayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka annī ashhadu annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā antal-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad, an taghfira lī dhunūbī innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You, bearing witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor was begotten, and none is comparable to Him — to forgive me my sins. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka annī ashhadu annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā antal-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad, ashkuruka wa lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, yā badī'as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūm, innī as'alukal-jannata wa a'ūdhu bika minan-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You, bearing witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor was begotten, and none is comparable to Him — I thank You, and there is no god but You alone with no partner. O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining — I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma bi'ilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika 'alal-khalq, aḥyinī mā 'alimtal-ḥayāta khayran lī, wa tawaffanī idhā 'alimtal-wafāta khayran lī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life is better for me, and take me when You know death is better for me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْقَطِعُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَّا بِزِينَةِ الْإِيمَانِ وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahādah, wa as'aluka kalimaṭal-ḥaqqi fir-riḍā wal-ghaḍab, wa as'alukal-qaṣda fil-ghinā wal-faqr, wa as'aluka na'īman lā yanqaṭi', wa as'aluka qurrata 'aynin lā tanqaṭi', wa as'alukar-riḍā ba'dal-qaḍā', wa as'aluka bardal-'ayshi ba'dal-mawt, wa as'aluka ladhdhatan-naẓari ilā wajhika wash-shawqa ilā liqā'ika fī ghayri ḍarrā'a muḍirrahin wa lā fitnatin muḍillah, Allāhumma zayyinnā bizīnatil-īmāni wa-j'alnā hudātan muhtadīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Your fear in secret and in public, and the word of truth in contentment and in anger, and moderation in wealth and poverty, and bliss that does not end, and coolness of the eye that does not cease, and contentment after Your decree, and the coolness of life after death, and the pleasure of looking at Your face and the longing to meet You, without any harmful adversity or misguiding trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith and make us guides who are guided.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ مَا يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغًا لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-rzuqnī ḥubbaka wa ḥubba man yuḥibbuka wa ḥubba mā yuqarribunī ilā ḥubbik, Allāhumma mā razaqtanī mimmā uḥibbu faj'alhu quwwatan lī fīmā tuḥibb, Allāhumma wa mā zawayta 'annī mimmā uḥibbu faj'alhu farāghan lī fīmā tuḥibb
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, grant me Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of what brings me closer to Your love. O Allah, whatever You have provided me of what I love, make it a strength for me in what You love. O Allah, whatever You have withheld from me of what I love, make it a freeing of my time for what You love.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْهَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ṭahhirnī minadh-dhunūbi wal-khaṭāyā, Allāhumma naqqinī minhā kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas, Allāhumma ṭahhirnī bil-mā'i wath-thalji wal-barad
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, purify me from sins and wrongdoings. O Allah, cleanse me of them as a white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, purify me with water, snow, and hail.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَسُوءِ الصَّدْرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الصَّدْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-bukhli wal-jubni wa sū'iṣ-ṣadr, wa fitnatīṣ-ṣadr, wa 'adhābil-qabr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from miserliness, cowardice, ill feeling in the chest, the trial of the chest, and the punishment of the grave.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَمُحَمَّدٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma rabba Jibrīla wa Isrāfīla wa Mīkā'īla wa Muḥammad, a'ūdhu bika minan-nāri wa min 'adhābil-qabr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, Lord of Jibreel, Israfeel, Mikaa'eel, and Muhammad, I seek refuge with You from the Fire and from the punishment of the grave.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma alhimnī rushdī wa a'idhnī min sharri nafsī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, inspire me with right guidance and protect me from the evil of my own soul.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa'
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge and I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwāti wa rabbal-arḍi wa rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīm, rabbanā wa rabba kulli shay', munzilat-tawrāti wal-injīli wal-furqān, a'ūdhu bika min sharri kulli dhī sharrin anta ākhidhun bināṣiyatih
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, our Lord and Lord of everything, Who sent down the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion — I seek refuge with You from the evil of every evil being whose forelock is in Your hand.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīnī wa aṣliḥ lī dunyāya wa aṣliḥ lī ākhiratī wa-j'alil-ḥayāta ziyādatan lī fī kulli khayr, wa-j'alil-mawta rāḥatan lī min kulli sharr
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, set right my religion for me, set right my worldly life for me, and set right my Hereafter for me. Make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a rest for me from every evil.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عَيْشَةً نَقِيَّةً وَمِيتَةً رَضِيَّةً وَمَرَدًّا غَيْرَ مُخْزٍ وَلَا فَاضِحٍ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ayshatan naqiyyatan wa mītatan raḍiyyatan wa maraddan ghayra mukhzin wa lā fāḍiḥ
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for a pure life, a contented death, and a return that is neither shameful nor disgracing.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الْمُلْكُ كُلُّهُ وَبِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ وَإِلَيْكَ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu kulluh, wa lakal-mulku kulluh, wa biyadikal-khayru kulluh, wa ilayka yurja'ul-amru kulluh
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, all praise is Yours, all dominion is Yours, all good is in Your hands, and to You all affairs return.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ النَّعِيمَ الْمُقِيمَ الَّذِي لَا يَحُولُ وَلَا يَزُولُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukanNa'īmal-muqīmal-ladhī lā yaḥūlu wa lā yazūl
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the lasting bliss that does not change and does not pass away.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ النَّعِيمَ يَوْمَ الْعَيْلَةِ وَالْأَمْنَ يَوْمَ الْخَوْفِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukanNa'īma yawmal-'aylati wal-amna yawmal-khawf
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for bliss on the day of destitution and security on the day of fear.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ḥabbib ilaynāl-īmāna wa zayyinhu fī qulūbinā, wa karrih ilaynāl-kufra wal-fusūqa wal-'iṣyān, wa-j'alnā minar-rāshidīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts, and make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to us, and make us of the rightly guided.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَمِتْنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَحْيِنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma amitnā muslimīna wa aḥyinā muslimīna wa alḥiqnā biṣ-ṣāliḥīna ghayra khazāyā wa lā maftūnīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, let us die as Muslims, let us live as Muslims, and join us with the righteous, without disgrace or being put to trial.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَاتِلِ الْكَفَرَةَ الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَيُكَذِّبُونَ رُسُلَكَ وَاجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزَكَ وَعَذَابَكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَذِّبِ الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ رُسُلَكَ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَأَوْصِلْ كِتَابَكَ إِلَى الْحَقِّ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma qātilil-kafaratalladhīna yaṣuddūna 'an sabīlika wa yukadhdhibūna rusulak, wa-j'al 'alayhim rijzaka wa 'adhābak, Allāhumma 'adhdhibilladhīna yukadhdhibūna rusulaka wa yaṣuddūna 'an sabīlik, wa awṣil kitābaka ilal-ḥaqq
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, fight the disbelievers who block Your path and deny Your messengers, and bring upon them Your punishment and torment. O Allah, punish those who deny Your messengers and block Your path, and make Your Book prevail over falsehood.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-hdinī wa-'āfinī wa-rzuqnī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me wellbeing, and provide for me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَزِدْنَا إِلَّا طِيبًا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا وَلَا تَهِنَّا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma lā tazidnā illā ṭīban, wa lā tanquṣnā wa lā tahinnā wa lā taḥrimanā wa lā tu'thir 'alaynā, war-ḍa 'annā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, increase us in nothing but goodness, and do not diminish us, do not humiliate us, do not deprive us, do not prefer others over us, and be pleased with us.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma aḥsin 'āqibatanā fil-umūri kullihā wa ajirnā min khizyid-dunyā wa 'adhābil-ākhirah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, make good our end in all of our affairs, and protect us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka yā Allāhu bi'annaka al-wāḥidul-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad, an taghfira lī dhunūbī, innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by the fact that You are the One, the Unique, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor was begotten and none is comparable to Him — to forgive me my sins. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ الْمَنَّانُ يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi'anna lakal-ḥamda lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lakal-mannān, yā badī'as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūm, innī as'alukal-jannata wa a'ūdhu bika minan-nār
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You by the fact that all praise belongs to You, there is no god but You alone with no partner, the Bestower of favors. O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining — I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا عَلَيْكَ قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbinā wa aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā wa-hdinā subulas-salām, wa najjinā minaẓ-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr, wa jannibnāl-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wa mā baṭan, wa bārik lanā fī asmā'inā wa abṣārinā wa qulūbinā wa azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā, wa tub 'alaynā innaka antat-tawwābur-raḥīm, wa-j'alnā shākirīna lini'matika muthnīna bihā 'alayk, qābilīhā wa atimmahā 'alaynā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, unite our hearts, set right what is between us, guide us to the paths of peace, take us from darkness into light, keep us away from indecencies both apparent and hidden, and bless us in our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses, and our offspring. Accept our repentance; indeed You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Your blessing, praising You for it, accepting it, and complete it upon us.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ وَثَبِّتْنِي وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayral-mas'alati wa khayrad-du'ā' wa khayran-najāḥi wa khayral-'amali wa khayrath-thawābi wa khayral-ḥayāti wa khayral-mamāt, wa thabbitnī wa thaqqil mawāzīnī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the best of asking, the best of supplication, the best of success, the best of deeds, the best of reward, the best of life, and the best of death. Keep me firm and make my scales heavy.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa ghalabatil-'aduwwi wa shamātatil-a'dā'
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from being overcome by debt, being overcome by the enemy, and the gloating of enemies.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَعَافِنِي أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ ضِيقِ الْمَقَامِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-hdinī wa-rzuqnī wa-'āfinī, a'ūdhu billāhi min ḍīqil-maqāmi yawmal-qiyāmah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, provide for me, and grant me wellbeing. I seek refuge with Allah from the tightness of the standing place on the Day of Resurrection.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ يَظْلِمُنِي وَأَرِنِي مِنْهُ ثَأْرِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma matti'nī bisam'ī wa baṣarī wa-j'alhumāl-wāritha minnī, wanṣurnī 'alā man yaẓlimunī wa arinī minhu tha'rī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and my sight and make them last until I die, and give me victory over those who wrong me and show me justice against them.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عَيْشَةً نَقِيَّةً وَمِيتَةً سَوِيَّةً وَمَرَدًّا غَيْرَ مُخْزٍ وَلَا فَاضِحٍ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ayshatan naqiyyatan wa mītatan sawiyyatan wa maraddan ghayra mukhzin wa lā fāḍiḥ
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for a pure life, a sound death, and a return that is neither shameful nor disgracing.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka an taṣimanī minash-shayṭānir-rajīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to protect me from the accursed Shaytān.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amal, wa a'ūdhu bika minan-nāri wa mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amal, wa as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qaḍā'in qaḍaytahū lī khayran
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it of words and deeds, and I seek refuge with You from the Fire and whatever brings one closer to it of words and deeds, and I ask You to make every decree You have decreed for me to be good.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوًّا وَلَا حَاسِدًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi qā'iman wa-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi qā'idan wa-ḥfaẓnī bil-islāmi rāqidan, wa lā tushmit bī 'aduwwan wa lā ḥāsidā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, protect me through Islam while I am standing, protect me through Islam while I am sitting, protect me through Islam while I am sleeping, and do not let any enemy or envier gloat over me.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ خَزَائِنِكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ خَزَائِنِكَ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min khayri khazā'inika wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri khazā'inik
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the good of Your treasuries and seek refuge with You from the evil of Your treasuries.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-qsim lanā min khashyatika mā taḥūlu bihi baynanā wa bayna maāṣīk, wa min ṭā'atika mā tuballighunanā bihi jannatak, wa minal-yaqīni mā tuhawwinu bihi 'alaynā maṣā'ibad-dunyā, wa matti'nā bi'asmā'inā wa abṣārinā wa quwwatinā mā aḥyaytanā, wa-j'alhu-lwāritha minnā, wa-j'al tha'ranā 'alā man ẓalamanā, wanṣurnā 'alā man 'ādānā, wa lā taj'al muṣībatanā fī dīninā, wa lā taj'alid-dunyā akbara hamminā wa lā mablagha 'ilminā, wa lā tusallīṭ 'alaynā man lā yarḥamunā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, apportion to us such fear of You as will come between us and acts of disobedience to You, and such obedience to You as will bring us to Your Paradise, and such certainty as will make the calamities of this world easy for us to bear. Let us enjoy our hearing, our sight, and our strength as long as You keep us alive and make them last until we die. Let our justice be upon those who wronged us, and give us victory over those who are hostile to us. Do not make our trial be in our religion, do not make this world our greatest concern or the utmost of what we aspire to, and do not give authority over us to those who will not have mercy on us.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَعِّدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَعَّدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ba'id baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, Allāhumma naqqinī minal-khaṭāyā kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas, Allāhumma-ghsil khaṭāyāya bil-mā'i wath-thalji wal-barad
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the East and the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow, and hail.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka yā Allāhul-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad, an taghfira lī dhunūbī, innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, the One, the Eternal, who neither begets nor was begotten and none is comparable to Him — to forgive me my sins. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka an tarfa'a dhikrī wa taḍa'a wizrī wa tuṣliḥa amrī wa tuṭahhira qalbī
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to raise my mention, remove my burden, set right my affairs, and purify my heart.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ وَخَوَاتِمَهُ وَجَوَامِعَهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَظَاهِرَهُ وَبَاطِنَهُ وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka fawātiḥal-khayri wa khawātimahu wa jawāmi'ahu wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu wa ẓāhirahu wa bāṭinahu wad-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the beginnings of good and its endings, its entirety, its first and its last, its outward and its inward, and the highest degrees of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ أَعِفَّ وَتَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتُحَصِّنَ فَرْجِي وَتُنَوِّرَ قَلْبِي وَتَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka an a'iffa wa tarfa'a dhikrī wa taḍa'a wizrī wa tuṣliḥa amrī wa tuṭahhira qalbī wa tuḥaṣṣina farjī wa tunawwira qalbī wa taghfira lī dhanbī, wa as'alukaD-darajātil-'ulā minal-jannah
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to make me chaste, raise my mention, remove my burden, set right my affairs, purify my heart, guard my chastity, illuminate my heart, and forgive my sin. And I ask You for the highest degrees of Paradise.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الصِّحَّةَ وَالْعِفَّةَ وَالْأَمَانَةَ وَحُسْنَ الْخُلُقِ وَالرِّضَا بِالْقَدَرِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma innī as'alukaṣ-ṣiḥḥata wal-'iffata wal-amānata wa ḥusnal-khuluqi war-riḍā bil-qadar
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for health, chastity, trustworthiness, good character, and contentment with Your decree.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْنِي هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma-b'athnī hādiyan mahdiyyā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, raise me as one who guides and is guided.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنِي الْحِكْمَةَ الَّتِي مَنْ أُوتِيَهَا فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ātinīl-ḥikmatal-latī man ūtiyahā faqad ūtiya khayran kathīrā
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, grant me wisdom, for whoever is granted it has been given much good.

zikr_from_book.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَمَنْ تَبِعَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
zikr_from_book.latin: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin wa aṣḥābihi wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi wa man tabi'ahum bi'iḥsānin ilā yawmid-dīn
zikr_from_book.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, his companions, his wives, his descendants, and those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgement.
